issues.description: The solution's PersonResource constructor has the wrong parameter type and does not initialize the personService field: it declares a constructor taking a NoteService and sets personService to null. The template declares a constructor taking a PersonService and the problem statement requires implementing person endpoints in PersonResource. This mismatch will cause confusion and runtime errors (personService is null) and prevents the intended wiring of PersonService into PersonResource.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution's PersonResource constructor to accept a PersonService parameter and assign it to the personService field (e.g. public PersonResource(PersonService personService) { this.personService = personService; }). This aligns the solution with the template and allows proper dependency injection and functioning of the endpoints.
